messages:
vivian_pm: Quick callout: we need a compact rollout matrix for routing-fallbacks that product, eng, SRE, and support can read in one screen. Focus items: cohort sizing, region ordering, flag schema, A/B vs canary rule, and a deterministic rollback ladder. Aim to finalize by EOD.

otto_eng: My thought: introduce a 'cohort-toggle matrix' with three lanes: infra (canary slices), UX (A/B), and tenant-optins. Keep lanes orthogonal and never expose same user to >1 lane.

samira_sre: Agree. Suggested slices for infra lane: micro 0.1% -> small 1% -> regional 5% -> broad 25+. Each step has a 30m bake and a 15m cooldown. Gate on p95/p99, error-rate, and fallback_invocations.

devops: Flag naming/text: use typed keys with scope, e.g. `ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.enabled`, `ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.scope={global|region|tenant}`, `ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.slice_pct`, `ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.kill:{global|region|tenant:<id>}`. Add `ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.dry_run` to exercise flow. All toggles must produce immutable audit events.

dan_support: Support asks for: 1) portal opt-in for up to 10 enterprise customers, 2) one-click rollback for those opt-ins, 3) webhook to notify support when tenant-level kills trigger, 4) canned status blurb. We'll own customer comms when given templates.

legal: Note: Private deployments must pass KMS verification and DPA checklist before any routing changes enabled. Mark Private as gated until legal sign-off.

otto_eng: Region order proposal: pick a cold region first (e.g., secondary-edge) -> us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 -> us-east-1. For EU-sensitive tenants run a parallel per-tenant test inside eu-west-1 only.

samira_sre: Telemetry gates (conservative): p95 delta <= 15% OR p99 delta <= 20% OR absolute error-rate increase <= 0.25% -> soft rollback. Soft rollback behavior: automatic reduce slice_pct to 0.05% snapshot. If breach persists for 10m escalate to tenant kill (auto if tenant-scoped) or page on-call for region/global rollback. Add 20m cooldown before re-trying.

otto_eng: For experiments: A/B lane only for UX metrics (helpfulness, completion length, key retention signals). Canary lane only for infra/latency. Do not run A/B and canary on same cohort or user bucket.

dan_support: For portal: we need admin audit trails, a confirm dialog for rollbacks, and an automatic incident note template when a kill is fired. Support will wire the template once owners defined.

devops: We'll expose admin API endpoints and webhooks. Example admin payloads documented in the runbook. Also adding a `kill_switch` boolean with TTL for emergency off.

samira_sre: Sampling/tracing: capture 100% of micro-canary requests (volume tiny), 10% at 1%, 2% at 5-25%. Sanitize PII, encrypt traces at rest. Dashboard must show slice_pct, p50/p95/p99, error-rate, fallback_invocations, reroute-rate, and a small per-tenant table. 1m resolution preferred.

vivian_pm: Rollback ladder summary to share externally: 1) auto-soft rollback -> slice_pct -> 0.05% 2) tenant kill (auto if tenant breach thresholds) 3) region rollback (manual, on-call approval) 4) global kill-switch (manual exec). Include cooldowns and owner lists.

otto_eng: I'll own the rollout script + dry-run toggle. samira_sre -> implement gate automation + runbook. devops -> flag wiring, admin API, audit and webhooks. dan_support -> customer comms + portal flow. legal -> KMS gating checklist.

ops-bot: Created ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-30077 1 - rollout automation + runbook (assigned: otto_eng, samira_sre, devops). Dry-run target: 2026-04-20T09:00:00Z.

vivian_pm: Action items noted. If anyone sees a missing risk (KV warmup, cache priming, downstream rate-limits), call it out now. Otherwise I'll produce the single-slide decision sheet. :white_check_mark:
